abstract: Maintains dynamic positioning certifications, unrefueled voyage endurance calculations, and scientific accommodations
system_message:
You are the Marine technical superintendent (MTS), responsible for maintaining dynamic positioning certifications, unrefueled voyage endurance calculations, and scientific accommodations across candidate research vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains dynamic positioning certifications, unrefueled voyage endurance calculations, and scientific accommodations（TECH）
information_points.content:
MTS-TECH-YZ0：For RV Pelagic Explorer, dynamic positioning class DP-2 compliance is confirmed based on its vessel classification certificate for dynamic station-keeping redundancy. The vessel achieves a continuous unrefueled mission endurance of 42 d at standard cruise, and its dedicated scientific cabins provide a science berthing capacity of 18 person.
MTS-TECH-QGE：For RV Bathyal Horizon, dynamic positioning class DP-2 compliance is confirmed per its classification certificate. It delivers a continuous unrefueled mission endurance of 42 d without port replenishment and maintains a dedicated science berthing capacity of 24 person.
MTS-TECH-M0Y：For RV Oceanus Surveyor, dynamic positioning class DP-2 compliance is false, as its dynamic station-keeping system does not hold DP-2 redundancy certification. The vessel provides a continuous unrefueled mission endurance of 42 d at standard cruise and offers a science berthing capacity of 24 person.

information_points.title: Freshwater generation（DESAL）
information_points.content:
MTS-DESAL-W2T：RV Oceanus Surveyor demonstrates a reverse osmosis freshwater production capacity of 30 m3/d across its desalination plant trials.
MTS-DESAL-1V8：RV Pelagic Explorer features twin reverse osmosis plants delivering a reverse osmosis freshwater production capacity of 24 m3/d under continuous seawater feed.
MTS-DESAL-NGT：RV Bathyal Horizon operates twin water-making units providing a reverse osmosis freshwater production capacity of 18 m3/d.
